title: 第3章 追杀牧帆第4章 接连反杀
content_zh:
深夜，明月被黑云遮挡，让大地都昏暗了几分。
时不时刮来的微风带着阵阵寒意，有些刺骨。
小院内。
望着眼前的两具尸体，牧帆神色平静无波。
对方都已经想杀他了，他自然不会手下留情。
“牧成虎敢让他们两个人来杀我，是因为有恃无恐，看来族中的高层是默认了这一做法！”
牧帆嘴角露出一抹嘲弄。
这样的家族，真是恶心！
“也是，在他们眼中，我不过是一个可有可无的废人…”
趁着天黑，牧帆决定立即连夜悄然离开牧府，只希望牧族不要再来找他麻烦，否则他可不会手软。
一来，他杀了牧山与牧河，留下来多半是会有大麻烦。
二来，这个牧族，牧帆已经不想继续待下去了，即使他能恢复到曾经的地位，也丝毫不感兴趣。
牧府中，即便是深夜，也时不时就会有巡逻队在走动。
牧帆避开之后，来到一处墙角，纵身一跃，就跨了过去。
转头望向生活了十三年的牧府，牧帆心情五味杂陈，更多的是失望。
“清风城是待不下去了，先出去一趟。”
牧帆转身离去。
深夜，清风城很安静，几乎看不到什么人。
牧帆进入一处小巷中，怕走大街上会被发现。
而这时，旁边大街上走来两个中年男子，身子摇摇晃晃，似乎是喝醉了。

“是他……”
牧帆急忙躲在一处墙角，内心疑惑不已。
两个摇摇晃晃的中年男子，一个名牧建阳，是牧成虎的父亲，同时也是大长老的儿子。
另外一个，并非是牧族的人，但是牧帆也见过，是宋族的高层人员。
牧族和宋族的人怎么会走一块儿？
何况，两人身份都不一般。
宋族，和牧族一样，是清风城三大家族之一，并且最为强势。
牧帆至尊武脉被废，多半和宋族脱不了干系。
因为牧族若是崛起，宋族肯定会被压制。
牧建阳嗜酒如命，经常喝得烂醉，这个牧帆是知道的。
然而，接下来两人的一番对话，让牧帆差点暴走。
只听那个宋族的中年男子以略微模糊不清的语气笑道：“建阳兄，你儿子即将成为你们牧族名正言顺的少族长，你的地位也会提升不少，是不是该表示点什么？要不是我们帮忙，你们可废不了牧帆那小子。”
牧建阳也有些醉意，但是脑子还清晰，笑道：“牧帆沦为废人，你们不也很高兴？”
“我们确实也高兴，但是，受益大的肯定是你们牧族大长老这一脉。”
宋族中年男子摇头，又道：“这事若是被人知道了，对我们宋族没有影响，对你们大长老一脉，不知道有没有影响呢？”
“难怪今天你非要故意来外面喝酒，还毫无忌惮的说这种话，你是想以此来作为威胁？”
content_en:
Late at night, the bright moon was obscured by black clouds, making the earth a little dark.
The breeze that blew from time to time brought with it a bit of chill, which was biting.
In the small courtyard.
Looking at the two corpses in front of him, Mu Fan looked calm.
The other party already wants to kill him, so he will naturally not show mercy.
"Mu Chenghu dared to let the two of them kill me because he was confident. It seems that the higher-ups in the clan have acquiesced in this approach!"
There was a hint of mockery on Mu Fan's lips.
Such a family is really disgusting!
"Yes, in their eyes, I am just a dispensable useless person..."
Taking advantage of the darkness, Mu Fan decided to leave the Mu Mansion quietly overnight, hoping that the Mu Fan would not come to trouble him again, otherwise he would not be lenient.
First, he killed Mu Shan and Mu He, and if he stayed, he would probably be in big trouble.
Secondly, Mu Fan no longer wants to stay with this herdsman, and even if he can return to his former status, he is not interested at all.
In the Mufu, even late at night, there would be patrols moving around from time to time.
After Mu Fan avoided it, he came to a corner, jumped over, and crossed over.
Turning his head to look at Mu Mansion, where he had lived for thirteen years, Mu Fan felt mixed emotions, mostly disappointed.
"I can't stay in Qingfeng City any longer. Let's go out first."
Mufan turned and left.
Late at night, Qingfeng City was very quiet, with almost no one in sight.
Mufan entered an alley, fearing that he would be discovered if he walked on the street.
At this time, two middle-aged men walked on the street next to them, their bodies swaying, and they seemed to be drunk.
"It's him..."
Mu Fan hurriedly hid in a corner, filled with doubts.
Two shaky middle-aged men, one named Mu Jianyang, is the father of Mu Chenghu and the son of the great elder.
The other one was not from the Mu tribe, but Mu Fan had seen him before, and he was a senior member of the Song tribe.
How come people from the Mu tribe and the Song tribe come together?
What's more, both of them have unusual identities.
The Song clan, like the Mu clan, is one of the three major families in Qingfeng City and is the most powerful.
Mu Fan's Supreme Martial Lineage was abolished, which was probably related to the Song clan.
Because if the Mu clan rises, the Song clan will definitely be suppressed.
Mu Jianyang was addicted to alcohol and often got drunk. Mu Fan knew this.
However, the following conversation between the two made Mufan almost go berserk.
The middle-aged man from the Song tribe laughed in a slightly unclear tone: "Brother Jianyang, your son is about to become the legitimate young patriarch of your herdsmen, and your status will also be improved a lot. Should you say something? If it weren't for our help, you wouldn't be able to destroy that kid Mu Fan."
Mu Jianyang was also a little drunk, but his mind was still clear. He smiled and said, "Aren't you also happy that Mu Fan has become a useless person?"
"We are indeed happy, but the ones who benefit the most will definitely be your lineage of great elders of the herdsmen."
The middle-aged man from the Song clan shook his head and said, "If this matter is known to others, it will have no impact on our Song clan, but will it have any impact on your lineage of great elders?"
"No wonder you came out to drink on purpose today and said such things without any scruples. Do you want to use this as a threat?"
